name: roguelike-your-life
description: Turn a context-aware AI chat into a roguelike-style life save report with character stats, relics, debuffs, active runs, bosses, failure drops, meta progression, and an ultra-long visual scroll.
privacy: Public examples must be fictional or anonymized. Never expose personal identifiers, private account handles, locations, finances, exact identifying dates, confidential achievements, credentials, or private conversation excerpts.
